content:
Hi :wave: , I'm sharing two pieces of work created with substantial help from Claude + Aristotle (Harmonic's automated prover). I'm new to this community and my contributions are from the PoV of a student seeking critical feedback.

  1. Machine-checked positivity for truncated Weil forms: exact certified thresholds. Includes what I believe is the first explicit machine-checked positivity window of the genuine zeta screw kernel (Link: https://github.com/gnostrich/certified-positivity/blob/main/papers/certified-positivity-paper.pdf)

  2. Self-extending correctness certificate for growing kernel matrices: positive-definiteness is monitored incrementally, every step is a theorem; halt yields explicit counterexample (Link: https://github.com/gnostrich/certified-positivity/blob/main/papers/certified-frontiers-paper.pdf)

Github Repo: https://github.com/gnostrich/certified-positivity
This topic was moved here from #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Machine-checked positivity for truncated Weil forms by Kevin Buzzard.

Hi Rohan,

Right now your Lean code is very unorganized. You should expose a public challenge.lean file that only imports mathlib and states exactly the theorem you are trying to prove, then check it against comparator.

Hi @Jack McCarthy ,

Thanks for taking the time to look at this :folded_hands: . I ran comparator per your suggestion.

It accepts the 16 headline theorems that use only the standard axioms (statement match against Challenge.lean, kernel-accepted) (https://github.com/gnostrich/certified-positivity/blob/main/Challenge.lean).

2 theorems proved via native_decide can't go through its replay stage (a known limitation of replay for compiled computation)

Everything is in the repo: bridge file (https://github.com/gnostrich/certified-positivity/blob/main/Solution.lean), configs and tool pins; and the check re-runs automatically in CI on every commit (https://github.com/gnostrich/certified-positivity/actions/runs/30246255088).

May I ask what made you, or the AI, add this to Main.lean and did it end up needed in any way?

set_option maxHeartbeats 8000000
set_option maxRecDepth 4000
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 20000
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 128
That's Aristotle's starter project template, it (annoyingly) always starts from those.

I seem to have truly showed how little I use AI for my Lean there just then huh, for better or worse :laughing:

Gotta lock in more to be replying on this channel!
@Yan Yablonovskiy 🇺🇦 just double checked it at my end, Snir's right, it's the prover's template
